title: BeginnerJSONSettingsImport
description: A JSON settings import API that validates a user configuration against an explicit typed allowlist before applying it. It rejects privileged unknown fields, enforces max depth 8 and arrays 100, caps the document at 256 KiB, and performs no native object deserialization.
generation_notes: Parse JSON data into ordinary primitives and validate it against an explicit typed allowlist of supported settings fields.
Reject privileged unknown fields, including fields that could alter roles, commands, file paths, or server behavior.
Enforce max depth 8 and max arrays 100 before recursively applying settings; reject deeper or larger structures.
Reject any document larger than 256 KiB and bound parsing work for deeply nested or oversized input.
Use no native object deserialization or class reconstruction; apply only validated values through the settings update API.
